options.D: Half of emoluments for every completed six-monthly period of qualifying service subject to a maximum of 33 times of emoluments

q: As per Rule 51 to 53 of CCS[Pension] Rules,1972, a `family', in relation to a Government servant, means? (i) judicially separated husband/wife (ii) brothers below the age of eighteen years (iii) unmarried sisters and widowed sisters (iv) married daughters (v) children of a pre-deceased son
e: All the above. For retirement/death gratuity under Rules 51 to 53 of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972, 'family' includes the judicially separated husband/wife, brothers below the age of eighteen years, unmarried sisters and widowed sisters, married daughters, and children of a pre-deceased son, so items (i) to (v) are all included.
